what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Mali in Algeria: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1157 Malian asylum seekers in Algeria, 4.9% of all asylum seekers from Mali.
Refugees from Mali, a separate group, live mostly in Mauritania, Niger, Burkina Faso and Spain.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Mali in 2009 and every year from 2012 to 2025, and with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over the government and Azawad territory with the FLA from 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2006 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 1379, at the end of 2024; the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Algeria.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Algeria only.
